quest.title: Traces of Back Pain
quest.description: It seems that Chalmet is having some trouble organizing files...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to bring me the file box on the <color=#00E1FFFF>table to the left</color> just inside the door?

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Thank you! It's really heavy, so be careful, and don't injure yourself... like me...

talks.objective: Help Chalmet retrieve the file box
Help Chalmet retrieve the file box
Help Chalmet retrieve the file box
Help Chalmet retrieve the file box

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Excellent! This is the one, thank you so much! You've been such a big help.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Please take these. And once I... Ow! Once I'm... a bit better, I can keep working...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will the Institute finally assign me an assistant...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Huh? I think you got the wrong box, but... it's fine, there's plenty of files in this one that need organizing too.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Please take these. And once I... Ow! Once I'm... a bit better, I can keep working...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will the Institute finally assign me an assistant...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: You... Why did you bring both boxes of files over?

choices.text: I forgot which one it was!

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Pffft... I guess that's just how you roll. Thanks! Both boxes have files I need to organize, anyway.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Since you've brought them both over, I should get going now. This is going to be a huge task!

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Please, take these, and thank you again for your help, Honorary Senior Researcher.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: *sigh* When will the Institute finally assign me an assistant...

choices.text: I thought you would need them both.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Your instincts are accurate as ever. Both boxes do indeed contain files I need to organize.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Ow... Why is that box so heavy...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: We meet again, Honorary Senior Researcher. I apologize... My... my lower back seems to have been injured, it hurts so badly...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: I was planning to move a box over here and organize the materials inside.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: I... I never imagined the box would be so heavy, and I couldn't quite keep my footing when I lifted it, so all the strain went straight to my waist...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Now I... It feels like my waist is broken, ow...

choices.text: Need me to carry you to a doctor?

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: No, no need... I've hurt my lower back before, I just need to rest a bit...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wonders just how many files are inside, for it to be this heavy...

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: There must be... Well, a ton of files. After all, the Institute once promoted a style of work called "Document Everything" for some time.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: Basically, it meant that absolutely a single thing at the Institute had to be physically documented.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: After they began promoting this policy, the Institute's paper usage increased 5 times...

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: And because there were so many documents, every single office was forced to create a "document management" post just to categorize and sort all the documentation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So everything had to be written down? That sounds really annoying...

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: It was! Later, that style was slowly phased out, and only implemented to a limited extent.

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: But let's not discuss that now... Honorary Senior Researcher, can you help me handle the file box? Though my waist hurts, I still need to organize the files inside...

response.speaker: Chalmet
response.text: No need to worry, I only need my hands to organize documents, I won't hurt my lower back further.

choices.text: I can call someone for you.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to bring me the file box on the <color=#00E1FFFF>table to the right</color> just inside the door?

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Thank you! It's really heavy, so be careful, don't injure yourself... like me...

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Well? Did you get me that box?
